title: Conjugacy and scalar invariance of local traces of finite Weil models
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$, a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. Use the framework finite coefficient-field categories [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and Weil pairs [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Let $E,E',L$ be finite subextensions of $\Qlb/\Ql$ with $E,E'\subset L$. Let $V_E=(M_E,\theta_E)$ and $V'_{E'}=(M'_{E'},\theta'_{E'})$ be Weil complexes and let
$$u:V_E\otimes_E L\xrightarrow{\sim}V'_{E'}\otimes_{E'}L$$
be an isomorphism of $L$-Weil pairs. In particular its underlying isomorphism obeys $u\theta_L=\theta'_L Lg_X^*(u)$; the extended Weil structures use the specified pullback/scalar comparisons of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex].

For $n\geq1$ and $x\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^n})$ let $C_{E,x}$ and $C'_{E',x}$ be the bounded finite-dimensional point complexes, and $F^{(n)}_{E,x}$ and $F'^{(n)}_{E',x}$ the local operators of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. Use the point transports $\iota$ and their naturality and scalar compatibility of [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural]. For $F\in\{E,E'\}$ write
$$b_{M_F}:C_{F,x}\otimes_F L\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Fib}_{s,L}L\bar x_L^*(M_F\otimes_F L)$$
for the composite of the inverse point-sections scalar comparison of [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension] with $\operatorname{Fib}_{s,L}$ of the rationalized pullback/scalar comparison for $\bar x$ of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]. All pullback-composition and pullback/scalar comparisons use the specified realization of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], rationalized as there, including their compatibility with equality of scheme morphisms and finite iterations. The isomorphism
$$\widetilde u_x=b_{M'_{E'}}^{-1}\circ(\operatorname{Fib}_{s,L}L\bar x_L^*u)\circ b_{M_E}:C_{E,x}\otimes_E L\xrightarrow{\sim}C'_{E',x}\otimes_{E'}L$$
satisfies
$$\widetilde u_x(F^{(n)}_{E,x}\otimes_E L)=(F'^{(n)}_{E',x}\otimes_{E'}L)\widetilde u_x.$$
The cohomology comparisons of [lem-weil-cohomology-commutes-scalar-extension] therefore identify the scalar-extended operators in every degree by conjugacy. For every $j\in\mathbf Z$, their ordinary linear traces [def-weil-endomorphism-trace] satisfy
$$\iota_E\operatorname{Tr}_E(H^j(F^{(n)}_{E,x}))=\iota_{E'}\operatorname{Tr}_{E'}(H^j(F'^{(n)}_{E',x}))\quad\hbox{in }\Qlb,$$
where $\iota_E:E\hookrightarrow\Qlb$ and $\iota_{E'}:E'\hookrightarrow\Qlb$ are the fixed inclusions. Equivalently, the scalar-extended traces in $L$ agree, with conjugacy and scalar trace interpreted by [prop-trf-trace-formal-laws](1),(3),(4) on field point complexes. This holds on the full constructible Weil-pair domain; no integral Weil lattice or finite-Tor condition on finite reductions is assumed.
